blocks.heading: Knockouts
lines: Every match knocks out one player, so n players need n − 1 matches.
With 2^k players there are k rounds. Otherwise give byes: byes = (next power of 2) − n.
In a standard draw of 2^k seeds, seed s plays seed 2^k + 1 − s in round 1: 1 v 16 in a 16-draw.
Two players can meet only in the round where their parts of the draw join.

blocks.heading: Upsets
lines: An upset is a match won by the lower seed.
To find the fewest upsets for a given result, look at each part of the draw the player must come through: if it holds a better seed, someone has to beat that seed.

blocks.heading: Leagues (round robin)
lines: Each pair meets once: n(n − 1) ÷ 2 matches, and each team plays n − 1.
With 2 points for a win and 1 each for a draw, every match gives 2 points in all.
With 3 for a win and 1 for a draw: total points = 3 × matches − number of draws.
Total wins = total losses, and total goals scored = total goals conceded.

blocks.heading: Method
lines: Build a team-by-team results table and fill the certain cells first.
Turn each team's points into its possible win-draw-loss mixes. 7 points from 3 matches at 3-1-0 can only be 2 wins and a draw.
"Did not lose" and "won exactly one" fix whole rows. Use them early.
When two cases survive, a question asking what must be true needs an answer true in both.
